observation: A working continuation launcher created momentum toward more training even though frontier comparison showed the current random-init 352M encoder, narrow corpus, sparse MLM-only objective, tiny ranking benchmark, and unused rationale fields were not yet the compute-optimal production path.
lesson: Do not equate a healthy training curve or available continuation script with the best next learning action. Compare parameter scale, data scale, objective signal density, curriculum semantics, and deployment-relevant evaluation against current frontier methods before spending scarce accelerator time.
generalization: When a pathfinder model has validated the pipeline but is structurally undertrained for available compute, preserve it as a baseline and redirect early. Sunk compute should not determine production architecture. Prefer smaller native students, broader governed data, denser objectives, explicit principle supervision, and end-to-end behavioral evaluation when those changes improve capability per compute without violating project invariants.
project_application: Hold N0 v0.1 step-2500 continuation. Design N0 v0.2 around native ~150-200M encoder scale, broader rights-clean corpus, modern MLM plus semantic/contrastive supervision, gradient-bearing rationale/principle signals, larger fixed benchmarks, and later multi-head identity policy evaluation across interchangeable generators.
